text:
maya: Quick ops thread for the "Virtual Open Lab: Inference at Scale" next Wed — need final ✅ on reg page + Zoom + post-event flow. Who can own?

sam: I can own the reg page and form fields. what's our gating? free / paid / invite-only?

maya: Free to register, but two tracks (Prod & Platform). We need track selector + checkbox for GDPR/marketing opt-in. Also capture: company, role, use-case tag (one-line), ok to pass lead to sales? yes/no.

leo: Zoom: I set host/co-host. Want cloud recording for full session + separate transcript VTT. Enable "Record active speaker with shared screen" and cloud auto-transcript. Turn off "Allow participants to join before host". Waiting room ON for first 5 min.

jen: For recordings, please use the naming convention: `2026-<event>-virtual-open-lab-<track>-<env>-<date>` e.g. `2026-virtual-open-lab-prod-2026-04-15`. Save to Marketing > Events/2026/OpenLab. Also enable "Automatically delete cloud recordings after 90 days"? (TBD)

maya: Sales & SDRs need leads in Salesforce asap. Sam + Kai, can we push registrant data to SFDC and also trigger an SFDC campaign membership? Prefer via Zapier or Segment.

kai: I'll build the Zapier zap: reg form (Typeform) -> Zapier -> SFDC create lead + add to campaign. Also fire webhook to `https://hooks.redwood.com/marketing/event-registrations` for analytics. Mapping snippet below:

```
// Zap mapping (Typeform -> SFDC)
registrant.email -> Lead.Email
registrant.first_name -> Lead.FirstName
registrant.last_name -> Lead.LastName
registrant.company -> Account.Name (create if missing)
registrant.track -> Lead.OwnerQueue (platform vs prod)
registrant.opt_in -> Lead.HasMarketingConsent__c
```

sam: Nice. Two asks: 1) Can we include a short qualifying dropdown: "Primary latency/cost challenge" (options: cold start, throughput, token cost, prompt quality) — that'll help SDRs. 2) Add a separate checkbox: "Send me the replay and demo assets" (so we can segment nurtures).

leo: Session moderation — who's on mics? Maya, Sam are hosts; Kai will do 10-min product demo; Jen will moderate Q&A and mark clips. Can we set co-hosts in Zoom now? @zoom-bot, please add co-hosts maya, sam, kai, jen.

zoom-bot: Scheduled meeting created. Meeting ID: 987-654-321. Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcript enabled. Co-hosts added: maya, sam, kai, jen. Recording link will be posted to #marketing after meeting ends.

jen: Post-event clip pipeline: marketing edits full recording -> choose 3x short clips (45-90s) + 1 long replay (30-45m). Deliver assets within 48h. Transcripts -> SRT for captions. Host video thumbnails: use event banner + speaker headshot (template in Figma).

maya: Distribution plan: 1) Send replay email to registrants within 24h with CTA to demo request; 2) Post replay on site gated behind email capture for unknown visitors; 3) Share clips to LinkedIn/Twitter with pinned benchmark stat.

sam: For gated replay, let's use a simple form that captures email and company and auto-matches to SFDC via same webhook. If no SFDC match, create contact and add to nurture campaign.

kai: Clips + timestamps we want: product demo (00:10:45-00:18:20), benchmark highlights (00:22:30-00:24:10), Q&A top question (01:05:00-01:07:10). Jen will timestamp live notes.

jen: I'll take notes in the shared doc and timestamp live. Post-event tasks checklist below:
- Download cloud recording -> GDrive Events/2026/OpenLab/full.mp4
- Export transcript -> events/2026/OpenLab/transcript.vtt & srt
- Create clips -> deliverable folder + thumbnails
- Upload to CMS + enable gated replay flow
- Notify sales w/ hot leads (attended + requested demo)

maya: Compliance/Qs: Confirm consent text on reg page: "By registering you consent to receive communications from Redwood Inference and to have your info shared with our partners and sales team." Also add link to privacy policy.

leo: One more ops note — please set Zoom recording access so only registrants + marketing team can view the raw recording. We'll generate public clips separately.

sam: I will update the Typeform and share the link in this thread when done. ETA EOD today.

maya: Awesome. Owners: Sam (registration + SFDC zap) / Kai (zap & demo) / Leo (Zoom + recording policy) / Jen (post-event clips + timestamps). I'll compile final runbook and post to Marketing > Events. :rocket:

jen: tiny ask — can we enable closed captions on the live Zoom meeting? Accessibility win.

leo: Yes — enabled.

maya: Cool. Closing thread when Sam drops the reg link. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
